g.text: Analyst Crew — CrewAI agents on the Blueprint 1 cluster
3 agents · 9 local tools · up to ~45 tool calls per question · every answer graded against ground truth

svg.text: 💻 Laptop — analyst_crew/ (Python 3.12 · pip install crewai · no DB server)
every ① below is an HTTP call to the cluster →
≤ AGENT_MAX_ITER (15) steps per agent · the prompt prefix never changes → prefix-cache hits on the cluster
tool calls run on the laptop
run_sql: one read-only SELECT · column_stats: median / p90
calculator: AST, no eval() · errors come back as text → agent retries
outputs capped at 40 rows / 2k chars to protect the context window
counted per call → tool-call totals in the report
accuracy · tool calls · LLM calls per run
+ cluster metrics over the run window
LLM calls & tokens: CrewAI event listener
bounded FIFO · 429 when full · 503 on timeout
agents' shared prefixes → same decode pod
returns OpenAI tool_calls, not JSON text
repeated agent prefixes reused across pods
vllm prefix hit rate · TTFT · preemptions
▶ python run.py eval --repeat 3 --concurrency 8 --prometheus http://localhost:9090 · offline test: tests/test_local.sh (scripted fake LLM)
